passages.text:
Session date: 3:09 pm on 15 September, 2023
[D28:5] Deborah: Wow, it was so special. A glimpse into her life beyond what I knew. Through their eyes, I appreciate her more. Here I am and my mom.
[D28:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women in pajamas taking a selfie in a mirror
[D28:6] Jolene: That looks like a blast! What did you and your mom's friends do on that day?
[D28:7] Deborah: We reminisced and looked through her photos. It was really sweet.
[D28:8] Jolene: Looking at old photos must have been so nostalgic! It's great that you could share that experience with friends. It's amazing how photos and memories can give us a deeper appreciation for the people we love.
[D28:9] Deborah: Pictures really have a way of bringing back memories and making us appreciate the special bond we have with our loved ones. They remind me of how strong love is and how amazing human relationships can be. Just like this one.
[D28:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D28:10] Jolene: Wow, what a gorgeous pic! Do you have any special memories of that beach or just love surfing in general?
[D28:11] Deborah: That beach is super special to me. It's where I got married and discovered my love for surfing. It's always filled with joy and peace.
[D28:12] Jolene: What pleasant memories.
[D28:13] Deborah: Here is another photo from my classes.
[D28:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D28:14] Jolene: Wow, that yoga pose looks amazing! Does it help you relax?
[D28:15] Deborah: Oh yeah! Doing this on the beach is so peaceful - the ocean, sand, and fresh air create a super relaxing atmosphere. The perfect way to take care of myself.
[D28:16] Jolene:  I like to create my own serene yoga space with candles and oils for extra chill vibes. Also, we tried a new style of meditation in Thailand - with flowers.
[D28:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a couple of towels sitting on top of a table
[D28:17] Deborah: Oh, same for me!
[D28:18] Jolene: I find calm when I do yoga or meditate. I use essential oils and put on some soft, soothing music in the background to create a peaceful atmosphere. It really helps me chill out and center myself.
[D28:19] Deborah:  It's amazing how our environment can enhance our practice.
[D28:20] Jolene: Yeah, totally! Our surroundings can really affect our mood and how much zen we can get from our routine. Creating a place that feels safe and chill is key.
[D28:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bed with a colorful blanket and pillows
[D28:21] Deborah: Wow, that looks so comfy and inviting! Where do you usually go to relax in your house?
[D28:22] Jolene: In my room, I usually go to relax and feel at ease. After a busy day, it's my little haven for peace and rest - the perfect spot to relax and recharge.
[D28:23] Deborah: Sounds like your room does the job. That's awesome.
[D28:24] Jolene:  Here are my pals keeping me company.
[D28:24] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a snake in a container
[D28:25] Deborah: Hey, that's Susie or Seraphim? How long has he been hanging out with you?
[D28:26] Jolene: It`s Susie! I've had her for two years now. 
[D28:27] Deborah: It's awesome how pets can bring us comfort and peace when we need it.
[D28:28] Jolene: Susie is a great companion.
[D28:29] Deborah: The love pets give is priceless.
[D28:30] Jolene: Plus, they make life a lot brighter!
Session date: 1:24 pm on 17 September, 2023
[D29:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, I'm so excited to tell you! Yesterday, me and my neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community, it was awesome! People of any age joined in and it was such a great thing to see.
[D29:2] Jolene: Wow, Deborah, that's awesome! Keep up the great work, and here's hoping for more events like this in the future!
[D29:3] Deborah:  Gardening is really amazing. It brings us together in such a cool way. It was awesome to share my love of plants and help people take care of the world. So, what about you? Anything new happened lately?
[D29:4] Jolene: We tried a scuba diving lesson last Friday and had an awesome time! We found a cool dive spot we can explore together. Trying new things opens up a world of adventure - maybe one day I'll be a certified diver. Anything fun going on with you?
[D29:5] Deborah: That sounds amazing, Jolene! I've been interested in underwater life, but I haven't had the chance to try scuba diving yet. Recently, I've been spending time remembering my mom. Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.
[D29:6] Jolene: Visiting your mom's old home sounds like it was really special. Is there something special you remember about her?
[D29:7] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! It was really special. My mom had a big passion for cooking. She would make amazing meals for us, each one full of love and warmth. I can still remember the smell of her special dish, it would fill the house and bring us all together.
[D29:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bowl of food with a spoon in it
[D29:8] Jolene: Mmm, that looks delicious, Deb! So sweet how cooking with your mom brought everyone together. What's your best memory of cooking with her?
[D29:9] Deborah: I loved it when she would bake pineapple birthday cakes for me when I was a kid. It always made me feel so special.
[D29:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pineapple cake with a smiley face on it
[D29:10] Jolene: No wonder it made you feel special. 
[D29:11] Deborah: Have you ever had something like that with someone close?
[D29:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a mixer with a whisk in it
[D29:12] Jolene: I used to bake cookies with someone close to me.
[D29:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of four chocolate chip cookies on a baking sheet
[D29:13] Deborah: What's your favorite cookie to make?
[D29:14] Jolene: The warm, gooey chocolate and soft, buttery cookie are a match made in heaven.
[D29:15] Deborah: I really want to eat this now.
[D29:16] Jolene: Well look what I have here!
[D29:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a book open on a bed
[D29:17] Deborah:  Is there anything special about it or the photo?
[D29:18] Jolene: It takes me to another world when I read it!
[D29:19] Deborah: Did I show you that I have a big bookshelf too?
[D29:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a couch and a book shelf
[D29:20] Jolene: I think not, I really like it!
[D29:21] Deborah: Having a space like this is important for escaping reality and relaxing with a book. Do you have any books that really moved you?
[D29:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bathroom with a black and white wall and a wooden stool
[D29:22] Jolene: My bathroom has an aesthetic vibe. Once I read a self-discovery book there and it really resonated with me.
[D29:23] Deborah: Wow! A special book that speaks to you and helps with self-discovery? That's awesome. Plus, having a cozy nook to chill? That's my best one!
[D29:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D29:24] Jolene: Sounds nice, Deb! A cozy nook is a must! The beach is a great place for finding peace and relaxation. Have you ever tried surfing?

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:42] Deborah: Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!
[D4:43] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'll definitely stay in touch. Bye, take care and keep shining!
[D4:44] Deborah: Stay safe!  Bye!
Session date: 9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023
[D5:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Been a few days since we last talked so I wanted to fill you in on something cool. Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.
[D5:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Sounds great. Taking time to reflect can be really awesome. Did you gain any new insights from it?
[D5:3] Jolene: Yep! I achieved so much more than I imagined. It was a real confidence boost.
[D5:4] Deborah: You deserve credit for stepping outside your comfort zone and believing in yourself. What cool stuff did you accomplish at the retreat?
[D5:5] Jolene: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.
[D5:6] Deborah: Let's go into more detail.
[D5:7] Jolene:  Green tech could really make a difference in disadvantaged areas. I'd like to look into it and see how I can contribute. Hey, speaking of helping out, I had an idea: a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids. What do you think of that?
[D5:8] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene! It's a great way to help and inspire others. They would benefit a lot from your knowledge. Have you thought of a plan yet?
[D5:9] Jolene: Haven't finished planning yet but I'm thinking of teaming up with local schools/centers to do workshops. We could even invite engineers as guest speakers to show kids their career options.
[D5:10] Deborah: Having guest speakers, like them, would definitely give the kids a real-world view. Have you reached out to any schools or centers yet?
[D5:11] Jolene: No, not yet. I want to solidify the plan first. Can't wait to start reaching out, though!
[D5:12] Deborah: That makes sense. I'm excited to hear how you reach out and help those kids. Let me know how it goes!
[D5:13] Jolene: I'll keep you posted! Appreciate the support! Here are my sketches in the planner.
[D5:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notebook with a page of notes
[D5:14] Deborah: Sounds like you're doing great. Let me know if you need more tips or information.
[D5:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! If I need anything else, I'll let you know. You're awesome!
[D5:16] Deborah: You're awesome too! Take care!
[D5:17] Jolene: Stay safe!
Session date: 4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023
[D6:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah, totally buzzing! Had a great night out last night - dinner, and drinks with my friends. So glad I got to let my hair down. You?
[D6:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a plate of food and a glass of wine
[D6:2] Deborah: Sounds great, Jolene! I just visited this place and it was so calming. Nostalgic too.
[D6:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a garden with a bunch of flowers in buckets
[D6:3] Jolene: Wow, those flowers are beautiful! What type are they? It looks so peaceful there.
[D6:4] Deborah: The roses and dahlias bring me peace. I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.
[D6:5] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your friend, Deb. Losing someone can be really tough. How are you holding up?
[D6:6] Deborah: Thanks for the kind words. It's been tough, but I'm comforted by remembering our time together. It reminds me of how special life is.
[D6:7] Jolene: Memories can give us so much comfort and joy.
[D6:8] Deborah: Memories keep our loved ones close. This is the last photo with Karlie which was taken last summer when we hiked. It was our last one. We had such a great time! Every time I see it, I can't help but smile.
[D6:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women are riding on a motorcycle on a dirt road
[D6:9] Jolene: Wow, looks like a great trip! Where else have you traveled?
[D6:10] Deborah: I've been blessed to travel to a few places and Bali last year was one of my favs. It was a gorgeous island that gave me peace, great for yoga.
[D6:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a swing on a beach with a blue sky
[D6:11] Jolene: Wow, that's great! Is yoga on the beach a thing? I've been wanting to try it.
[D6:12] Deborah: The sound of the waves and the fresh air is wonderful!
[D6:13] Jolene: I'll definitely give it a go! It sounds peaceful. Thanks!
[D6:14] Deborah: Let me know how it goes. Enjoy it!
[D6:15] Jolene: I'll keep you posted if I decide to go there.
[D6:16] Deborah: Take care!
Session date: 4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023
[D7:1] Jolene: Hi Deborah, it's been a while! Since we last talked, so much has happened. Balancing engineering school with my partner's video games is quite a feat. But I'm also setting aside time for myself, doing yoga and meditation. It helps give me calm amidst the craziness.
[D7:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great to hear from you. Taking a break is key. How have those practices been helping with everything?
[D7:3] Jolene: They seriously saved me. I chill out and gain perspective when I do yoga. Afterward, I'm more alert and motivated. Here is my last photo.
[D7:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat doing a yoga pose
[D7:4] Deborah: Wow, cool that yoga has been helping you out! Do they also do yoga with you? Does your partner do yoga with you?
[D7:5] Jolene: He started joining me sometimes, which is nice for bonding and relaxing. It's brought us closer. This is just our random photo.
[D7:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and a woman holding hands with rings on them
[D7:6] Deborah: Aw, that's wonderful! How long have you been married?
[D7:7] Jolene: We're not married yet but we've been together for three years. We're taking it slow and loving the ride. This ring on his hand is just a decoration, not a wedding ring.
[D7:8] Deborah: Sounds nice, Jolene. Enjoying the journey is the main thing. So, how did you two meet?
[D7:9] Jolene: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great!
[D7:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book and a calculator on a table
[D7:10] Deborah: Wow, your relationship started from a strong friendship. Do you still enjoy working on engineering projects together?
[D7:11] Jolene: Yep, teaming up for these projects feels great! We get each other's struggles and both love it.
[D7:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of men standing in front of a building
[D7:12] Deborah: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
[D7:13] Jolene: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.
[D7:14] Deborah: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!
[D7:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.

passages.title: LoCoMo conv-48 history chunk 7
passages.text:
Session date: 7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023
[D15:4] Jolene: Deborah, that's awesome! Being part of a supportive group must be super motivating. Finding a team that's passionate about something makes a huge difference. Just thinking about my own journey too.
[D15:5] Deborah: Having people who can cheer you on and give you advice really makes a difference. What has it been like for you finding supportive folks?
[D15:6] Jolene: Gaming's been tough lately, but I'm grateful I have someone who's also into it. My partner helps me stay focused on our goals. We have a lot of cute photos, I want to share with you.
[D15:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer
[D15:7] Deborah:  What do you like best about gaming together?
[D15:8] Jolene: We get to tackle challenges and have a shared experience. It's always a blast when we're into the same game and achieve something tough. Plus, it's a great way to bond and get closer.
[D15:9] Deborah: Woah, that's cool! Gaming is so good for strengthening relationships. Do you two have a favorite game to play together?
[D15:10] Jolene: Yeah, we love playing "It takes two" together! It's a fun team-strategy game and it's competitive. Plus, it's a great way for us to bond. Do you have any activities you like doing with people?
[D15:11] Deborah: Yep, I do running and yoga/meditation with others. Connecting with people and creating a community is great. Plus, I love organizing workshops and events to practice mindfulness and self-care. It's an awesome way to have fun, build relationships, and support each other's growth.
[D15:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park
[D15:12] Jolene: Sounds like a great way to relax. What do your workshops and events involve?
[D15:13] Deborah: It involves various activities such as yoga, meditation, and self-reflection. They aim to cultivate self-awareness, promote mental and emotional well-being, and help individuals find inner peace. It's a space where people can connect, explore, and grow.
[D15:14] Jolene:  Your events are awesome for helping people connect and learn, it is so important. How has everything been going for you?
[D15:15] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! It's been great seeing everyone come together and support each other. It's amazing to witness the growth and transformation that happens through these workshops. I'm honored to be a part of it.
[D15:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a game board with a bunch of cards on it
[D15:16] Jolene: Wow, Deb! I can imagine how rewarding it must be to create a space for growth and change. It's great to hear that everything's going well. You can always count on me for support! I just want to share a photo with you.
[D15:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake on a branch with a book
[D15:17] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! Your support means a lot to me. I'm here for you too. By the way, I noticed your pet in the picture. What made you decide to get a snake?
[D15:18] Jolene:  I was fascinated by reptiles, and it felt like the perfect pet for me. Taking care of it has been really calming, and it's a great way to connect with nature.
[D15:19] Deborah:  Glad you found something that gives you peace and calm. Do you have a favorite memory with "it" to share?
[D15:20] Jolene: I have lots of great memories, like our little 'snake adventure'. She got out and I spent hours searching, so relieved when I finally found her snuggling under the bed. It really showed how much I love her.
[D15:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake in a tank with sand and plants
[D15:21] Deborah: What was it like when you found her? I can imagine the relief!
[D15:22] Jolene: Seeing her snuggled under the bed made me feel so much love and gratitude. It made me realize how important she is to me.
[D15:23] Deborah: They bring so much joy and remind us of what's important.
[D15:24] Jolene: Animals teach us a lot about love and gratitude, and they bring so much joy. 
[D15:25] Deborah: I haven't introduced you to my pets yet! I don't like dogs, that's why I have cats.
[D15:25] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket
[D15:26] Jolene: Looks like they're having a blast! How often do you take them out?
[D15:27] Deborah: Exercise and nature are really important to me, so I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening.
[D15:27] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D15:28] Jolene: Wow Deb, that's great! I'd love to experience that every day.
[D15:29] Deborah: Nature helps me find peace every day - it's so refreshing!
[D15:30] Jolene: It's a pity that my snakes don't run!  I'd love to do that more often. They would motivate me and together it would be more fun.
[D15:30] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D15:31] Deborah:  It's like hitting a reset button that helps me put things into perspective and gives me time to reflect.
[D15:32] Jolene: Yeah, I totally get it. Whenever I can, I love going for walks to take it all in. And I take photos like this
[D15:32] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunset over a body of water
[D15:33] Deborah: It's amazing how nature has the power to bring us peace and clarity.
[D15:34] Jolene: This photo captures the peacefulness of a lake surrounded by trees.
[D15:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dock on a lake with trees in the background
[D15:35] Deborah: Why did you choose that spot? It looks so calm.
[D15:36] Jolene: It's such a hidden gem! It makes me feel so peaceful and tranquil.
[D15:37] Deborah: Lucky you for having somewhere to relax and tune out!
[D15:38] Jolene: We'll definitely go there together sometime!
[D15:39] Deborah: We all need a timeout!
Session date: 9:26 am on 1 August, 2023
[D16:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great news - I just started a project for a cleanup in our community and have been trying to raise funds for it. It's been amazing to see everyone come together to make a difference. How've you been? Anything new going on?
[D16:2] Jolene: Hey Debs! Congrats on your project for the community! As for me, life's been a rollercoaster lately. Last week, I had a huge setback with my project. I put in so much work and it all crashed and I lost everything. SO frustrating and depressing.
[D16:3] Deborah: Jolene, sorry to hear that. It must be really tough. I'm here for you and if I can do anything, just let me know. Is there anything that's helping you cope?
[D16:4] Jolene: Your support means a lot. Susie really helps when times get tough. Pets have been great company. Video games have also been a nice distraction.
[D16:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man holding a snake on his arm
[D16:5] Deborah: They can really provide love and comfort, especially during tough times. How did you come to have Susie?
[D16:6] Jolene: I adopted her two years ago when I was feeling lonely and wanted some company.
[D16:7] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Animals sure have a way of bringing us happiness. They understand us and provide us with comfort. Plus, having a pet teaches us responsibility. She came at the perfect time - cherish those moments with her and find strength in her presence.
[D16:8] Jolene: Thanks Deborah. Having her around shows me I can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.
[D16:9] Deborah: Enjoying the little things is key. Those little moments can give us a boost and push us forward. How have you been taking care of yourself lately?

Session date: 4:06 pm on 23 January, 2023
[D1:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, nice to meet you! How's your week going? Anything fun happened?
[D1:2] Jolene: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?
[D1:3] Deborah: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.
[D1:4] Jolene: Why does it hold such special memories for you?
[D1:5] Deborah: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.
[D1:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair
[D1:6] Jolene: Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?
[D1:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a bench and a window
[D1:7] Deborah: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.
[D1:8] Jolene: Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris.
[D1:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a heart shaped pendant with a bird on it
[D1:9] Deborah: Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother. And what is special for you about your jewelry?
[D1:10] Jolene: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.
[D1:11] Deborah: It should really give you strength and energy!
[D1:12] Jolene: Do you have goals?
[D1:13] Deborah: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.
[D1:14] Jolene: What inspired you to go down this route?
[D1:15] Deborah: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.
[D1:16] Jolene: It is truly inspiring!
[D1:17] Deborah: Gotta run, bye!
[D1:18] Jolene: Looking forward to the next chat!
Session date: 9:49 am on 27 January, 2023
[D2:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, sorry to tell you this but my dad passed away two days ago. It's been really tough on us all - his sudden death left us all kinda shell-shocked. I'm trying to channel my grief by spending more time with family and cherishing the memories. These moments remind me to live life fully.
[D2:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman hugging a woman who is sitting on a couch
[D2:2] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your dad, Deborah. Losing a parent is tough - how's it going for you and your family?
[D2:3] Deborah: Even though it's hard, it's comforting to look back on the great memories. We looked at the family album. Photos give me peace during difficult times. This is my parents' wedding in 1993.
[D2:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bride and groom posing for a picture
[D2:4] Jolene: They were a beautiful couple!
[D2:5] Deborah: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!
[D2:6] Jolene: What do you value in your relationship?
[D2:7] Deborah: It is love, and openness that have kept us close all these years. Being there for each other has made us both happy. Look what letter I received yesterday!
[D2:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a note written to someone on a piece of paper
[D2:8] Jolene: What touching words! Who is this letter from?
[D2:9] Deborah: The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them. Those moments remind me why I'm so passionate about yoga.
[D2:10] Jolene: Where do you most often do yoga?
[D2:11] Deborah: This is one of the places where I do it.
[D2:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a television and a window
[D2:12] Jolene: Where is it?
[D2:13] Deborah: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.
[D2:14] Jolene: Must be great to have that place where you feel connected to her.
[D2:15] Deborah: Yeah, it's special. I can feel her presence when I sit there and it comforts me.
[D2:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a window seat in a room with a window
[D2:16] Jolene: Wow, it sounds like that spot holds a lot of sentimental value. Does it bring back any special memories?
[D2:17] Deborah: Yeah, Jolene. She'd sit there every night with a book and a smile, reading was one of her hobbies. It was one of her favorite places in the house. 
[D2:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a view of the sky from an airplane window
[D2:18] Jolene: What other hobbies did your mother have?
[D2:19] Deborah: Travel was also her great passion!
[D2:20] Jolene: I want to show you one of my snakes! They always calm me down and make me happy. This is Susie.

Session date: 3:56 pm on 6 June, 2023
[D13:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Long time no talk - I had lots of stuff going on. Remember the tough engineering project? I finally wrapped that up last month. Look at the result!
[D13:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a solar powered vehicle with a solar panel on the back
[D13:2] Deborah: Jolene! Congrats on wrapping up your with it! You really put in the work and it paid off. 
[D13:3] Jolene:  I'm really proud of myself for sticking it out despite the problems and finishing it. It's definitely a big milestone.
[D13:4] Deborah: Now that you've reached this big milestone, what do you have planned next?
[D13:5] Jolene:  I'm interning at a well-known engineering firm. It's been a great opportunity to test my skills and gain real-world experience. These are my new colleagues!
[D13:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of construction workers posing for a picture
[D13:6] Deborah: What's been the best part of it so far?
[D13:7] Jolene: The best part so far has been being able to apply what I learned in school to real projects. It's so fulfilling to see my ideas come to life.
[D13:8] Deborah: Mind if I ask how the internship has impacted you?
[D13:9] Jolene: It has had a positive impact on my life. It has stoked my love of engineering and has encouraged me to keep striving for my dreams.
[D13:10] Deborah:  How has it inspired you to keep striving for your dreams?
[D13:11] Jolene: Hanging out with people who love what they do has really inspired me to stay focused and keep working towards my goals. It's shown me that with dedication and effort, anything is possible.
[D13:12] Deborah: Have you been able to find a good work-life balance during your internship?
[D13:13] Jolene: Honestly, finding that balance has been tough. I've been slogging away and it's been hard to make time for my hobbies and chilling out.
[D13:14] Deborah:  Have you considered taking some breaks and finding activities like yoga to help you relax and unwind? That might make a difference.
[D13:15] Jolene: Yeah, I`m trying to do it. Here's an example of how I spent yesterday morning, yoga on top of mount Talkeetna.
[D13:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man standing on a rock with his arms outstretched
[D13:16] Deborah: Nice job, Jolene! How long have you been doing yoga and meditation? It looks like it's really helping you regroup and recharge.
[D13:17] Jolene: I've been doing them sporadically for about 3 years now and they've had a real positive effect on me.
[D13:18] Deborah: Has it benefited you in any way? Have you found it helpful in difficult moments?
[D13:19] Jolene: It has helped me with stress and kept me centered.
[D13:20] Deborah: Glad they've been helpful for you!
[D13:21] Jolene: No idea how I would've survived without them!
[D13:22] Deborah: This is my favorite studio and it's always so calming. 
[D13:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a bench and a window
[D13:23] Jolene:  I was wondering if you have any advice on calming the mind and breathing during yoga?
[D13:24] Deborah: I'd recommend practicing mindful breathing for yoga. Set aside a few minutes each day to sit with your eyes closed, take deep breaths, and focus on how the air feels entering and leaving your body. 
[D13:25] Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! I'll definitely give it a try. Appreciate the advice!
[D13:26] Deborah:  If you need more tips or help, just let me know. Take care!
[D13:27] Jolene: See you!
Session date: 9:17 am on 26 June, 2023
[D14:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! How's it going? We haven't talked in a while. I've been busy getting ready for a yoga retreat with some buddies. A chance to hang out with people who think like me and find peace and understanding. Sounds awesome!
[D14:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park
[D14:2] Jolene: Hey Deb! Been super hectic with internship and stuff. That retreat sounds awesome, I could definitely use a break!
[D14:3] Deborah: By the way, I tried a new pose - Dancer Pose (Natarajasana). Rate, did I succeed?
[D14:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D14:4] Jolene: You are amazing as always! Here are new photos of Seraphim in the new aquarium that I bought the day before yesterday.
[D14:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake curled up in a plant filled area
[D14:5] Deborah: Where'd you get it? I'm always drawn to animals, they bring so much joy. What's its story?
[D14:6] Jolene:  I got her last year, she's a great pet. She always cheers me up and brings a sense of peace. Spending time with her is so comforting.
[D14:7] Deborah: Pets really do make life more enjoyable and bright. 
[D14:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a field
[D14:8] Jolene:  I'm so thankful it's here. Plus, it's nice to have a calm creature around.
[D14:9] Deborah: How have things been besides that?
[D14:10] Jolene: Things have been intense lately. I'm really pushing myself to succeed, and sometimes it feels overwhelming. But I'm determined to overcome any obstacles and achieve my goals.
[D14:11] Deborah: Keep up the hard work and remember to relax too.
[D14:12] Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! I had a big breakthrough with this project - so exciting and rewarding!
[D14:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a drawing of a house with a ruler and a ruler
[D14:13] Deborah: Awesome, Jolene! I'm really glad your project worked out. 
[D14:14] Jolene: Stop talking about me, tell me more about your retreat.
[D14:15] Deborah: I'd rather show you a photo. This is also a new yoga pose that we tried. It is a tree pose.
[D14:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of three people standing in front of a large statue
[D14:16] Jolene: What's that statue in the picture?
[D14:17] Deborah: It's a symbol of peace and enlightenment.
[D14:18] Jolene: Wow, it looks gorgeous! I'd love to visit a retreat like that. It seems like the ideal spot to find peace and refreshment.
[D14:19] Deborah: It's perfect for reflecting and getting centered.
[D14:20] Jolene: I could really use some chill time like that. Sounds so peaceful.
[D14:21] Deborah: Yeah, we all need some peaceful time to relax.
[D14:22] Jolene: Gotta run, have a nice day!
[D14:23] Deborah: See you!
[D14:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunset reflecting in a lake with a boat
Session date: 7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023
[D15:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! I started a running group with Anna - it's awesome connecting with people who care about fitness!
[D15:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of three men standing next to each other on a road
[D15:2] Jolene: Cool, Deb! Glad you found some people to get fit with. I'm trying to add workouts into my studying schedule, which has been tough but fun. How about you? Any challenges with the running group?
[D15:3] Deborah: Oh, I'm having a blast with it! We help and push each other during our runs, which makes it so much easier to stay motivated.  I have a lot of my photos from this activity.
[D15:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman standing on a sidewalk with a skateboard
